jica_manual_ref: Inspired by JICA SHEP PLUS — Capsicum (sweet pepper) manual

varieties.name: Yolo Wonder
varieties.supplier_notes: Larger fruit, slightly more disease tolerant.

timeline_template.description_en: Sow seed in nursery trays, 0.5cm depth, in sterile media.
Harden seedlings — reduce water, expose to sun.
timeline_template.description_sw: Tayarisha miche kwa jua, punguza maji.

timeline_template.description_en: Transplant 5-week seedlings at 60cm x 45cm. Water heavily after.
Stake tall plants 1.5m to prevent lodging when fruits weigh.
Spray for aphids and thrips at first sign of curl/silvering.
timeline_template.description_sw: Nyunyuza dawa ya wadudu ukianza kuona majani yamejikunja.

timeline_template.description_en: Scout whitefly and aphids weekly — they carry the viruses that ruin capsicum.
timeline_template.description_sw: Chunguza nzi weupe na vidukari kila wiki — wanaeneza virusi vya pilipili hoho.
CAN ya pili wakati wa maua.

timeline_template.description_en: Cut peppers at full size, glossy green. Twist + pull is wrong — use shears.
timeline_template.description_sw: Kata pilipili zikiwa kubwa na kung'aa. Tumia mkasi.
timeline_template.tip_en: Pick every 5-7 days. Red peppers fetch 1.5x green prices.
timeline_template.tip_sw: Vuna kila siku 5-7. Pilipili nyekundu hupata bei mara 1.5.

post_harvest.grading_criteria: Grade A: blocky, firm, glossy. Grade B: minor sun-scald or scarring.
post_harvest.packaging_standard: 20kg crates lined with paper to avoid bruising.
post_harvest.storage_tips_sw: 7-10°C ndiyo bora. Epuka chini ya 7°C — huharibika kwa baridi.

diseases.severity_classes: Low (adults present) · High (curled leaves, no fruit set)
diseases.symptoms_en: Whitefly clouds on undersides, upward curled yellow leaves, flower drop, stunted fruit.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Makundi ya nzi weupe chini ya majani, majani yaliyokunjika na manjano, maua huanguka.
diseases.treatment_en: Spray registered whitefly products early; remove infected plants. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Nyunyuza dawa zilizoidhinishwa mapema; ng'oa mimea iliyoathirika. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Mitego ya kunata, vizuizi, aina sugu.
diseases.scanner_notes: Curling + whitefly presence = virus pattern; photograph the underside with insects.

diseases.symptoms_en: Colonies curl new growth and vector viruses.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Makundi yanakunja majani machanga na kueneza virusi.
diseases.treatment_en: Squash early colonies; registered products only if spreading. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Ponda makundi ya mwanzo; nyunyuza tu ikiwa yanaenea. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Chunguza chini ya majani kila wiki.
diseases.scanner_notes: Underside photo with the colony visible.

diseases.symptoms_en: Silver-bronze fruit scarring, distorted leaves, dry spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Matunda yenye makovu ya fedha, majani yaliyopinda, kiangazi.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered products at threshold only. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa tu wakati wamezidi. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Hifadhi maadui wa asili, chunguza mara kwa mara.

diseases.symptoms_en: Green wilt in heat, recovery at night then permanent; white ooze from cut stem.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Kunyauka kijani jua, kupona usiku kisha kunyauka kabisa; ute mweupe kwenye shina lililokatwa.
diseases.treatment_en: No cure — rogue and destroy; 3-season rotation away from tomato/potato/pepper. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Hakuna tiba — ng'oa na uteketeze; zungusha miaka 3 mbali na nyanya/viazi/pilipili. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Zungusha mazao, vitanda vilivyoinuliwa, epuka mafuriko.
diseases.scanner_notes: Cut-stem-in-water test is the in-app verification.

diseases.symptoms_en: Dark stem lesions at soil line, water-soaked fruit rot, wilting in wet spells.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Vidonda vyeusi kwenye shina, matunda yanayooza, kunyauka mvua nyingi.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered blight-active sprays preventatively in wet weather. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa za blight kama kinga wakati wa mvua. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Drainage, raised beds, no overhead watering.
diseases.prevention_sw: Mifereji ya maji, vitanda vilivyoinuliwa, usimwagilie kutoka juu.
diseases.scanner_notes: Stem-base photo + fruit close-up; wet-season timing is diagnostic.

diseases.symptoms_en: White powder on both leaf sides, yellowing, fruit exposed to sun.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Unga mweupe pande zote za jani, kuwitikia, matunda yanachomwa na jua.
diseases.treatment_en: Sulphur-class or registered mildew products at first dusting. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa za salfa au zilizoidhinishwa mara inapoanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_sw: Hewa ya kutosha, epuka mkazo wa maji.
diseases.scanner_notes: White powder on TOP of leaf distinguishes from downy mildew.

diseases.severity_classes: Low (specks) · High (sunken rot on ripe fruit)
diseases.symptoms_en: Sunken dark circular spots on ripening fruit, pink spore ooze in humidity.
diseases.symptoms_sw: Madoa meusi yaliyozama kwenye matunda yanayoiva, ute wa pinki unyevu.
diseases.treatment_en: Registered anthracnose-active sprays from first colour. Advisory: use PCPB-registered products only, at label rates.
diseases.treatment_sw: Dawa zilizoidhinishwa za anthracnose tangu rangi ya kwanza. Shauri: tumia dawa zilizoidhinishwa na PCPB tu, kwa kiwango kilichoandikwa.
diseases.prevention_en: Never leave ripe fruit hanging, handle gently.
diseases.prevention_sw: Usiache matunda yaliyoiva shambani, shika kwa upole.
diseases.scanner_notes: Photograph the fruit, not leaves — leaf photos miss it entirely.

market_notes.sell_windows_en: Coloured peppers carry the premium — decide before planting whether your buyer pays for colour. Pick twice weekly; fruit left on the plant slows the next set.
market_notes.sell_windows_sw: Pilipili za rangi zina bei ya juu — amua kabla ya kupanda kama mnunuzi analipa rangi. Vuna mara mbili kwa wiki.
market_notes.price_notes_en: Farm-gate ~60–120 KES/kg green, 150–300 KES/kg coloured (November 2026). Grading ladder: export → supermarket → open market; each rung is roughly half the next.
market_notes.price_notes_sw: Bei ya shambani ~60–120 KES/kg kijani, 150–300 KES/kg za rangi (Novemba 2026). Ngazi ya daraja: nje → duka kubwa → soko wazi.
